Meet the maker

AA

Dr. Arowolo Ayoola

Dr. Arowolo Ayoola is a researcher and a leader. He started a company called Data-Lead Africa, where his team studies what really helps families, schools and hospitals across Africa, and then helps leaders make better choices.


He believes Africa needs brave, honest leaders who keep going when the road is hard. He made Lead Quest so that you can learn from the greatest leadership stories ever written, one brave step at a time.


Who knows? One day, people might tell stories about the way you led.
